check_avatar.description: Check whether an email address has a Gravatar picture, and when it last changed. Gravatar doesn't count these checks against its hourly allowance, so this suits going through a whole contact list before deciding whose photo to use. No API key required.

mock_response.summary: m@mullenweg.com has a Gravatar picture, last changed 2014-11-16

check_avatar.name: check_avatar

parameters.description: The person's email address. Their Gravatar username (the matt in gravatar.com/matt) or profile link works too.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: Optional. People rate their own pictures; anyone whose picture is rated higher than this counts as having none. G, suitable for everyone, by default.
parameters.name: rating

options.label: PG: may show rude gestures, revealing clothing or mild violence
R: may show harsh language, violence or nudity
X: may show explicit sexual images or disturbing violence

avatar_url.description: A link to their picture at Gravatar's default 80 pixels, or null when they have none.

has_avatar.description: True when the person has uploaded a Gravatar picture rated at or below the rating asked for.

hash.description: Gravatar's anonymous id for the email address (its SHA-256 hash). Every Gravatar step accepts it in place of the address.

looked_up.description: The email address (lower-cased) or username the step looked up, so a result can be matched back to its row.

rating.description: The most mature rating allowed: 'g', 'pg', 'r' or 'x'.

summary.description: One line saying whether they have a picture, e.g. 'm@mullenweg.com has a Gravatar picture, last changed 2014-11-16'.

updated_at.description: When they last changed their picture, as an ISO 8601 time in UTC, e.g. '2014-11-16T16:29:04Z'. Null when they have no picture.

find_profiles_by_account.description: Find the Gravatar profiles that have verified an account with a given username on another service, such as GitHub, LinkedIn or X: a way from someone's GitHub username to their name, photo and other accounts. Results come a page at a time. No API key required.

get_avatar.description: Get a link to someone's Gravatar picture at the size you choose, ready for a CRM photo field, a chat message or an email, and optionally save the picture as a file to attach or upload. People without a Gravatar get the stand-in you pick (a silhouette, their initials, a pattern...), and Has avatar says which the link shows. No API key required.

mock_response.summary: m@mullenweg.com has a Gravatar picture, last changed 2014-11-16

get_profile.description: Look up the public Gravatar profile behind an email address: the person's name, photo, About text, location, job title, company, pronouns and the social accounts Gravatar has verified for them (up to four). Useful for filling in a new contact or lead from nothing but their email. An address with no public profile comes back with Found set to false instead of failing the step. No API key required.

get_qr_code.description: Get a QR code that opens someone's Gravatar profile when scanned, for a name badge, a business card or an email signature. Choose its size, its style and what sits in the middle, and optionally save it as a PNG file. People without a public profile are refused, since their code would open an empty page. No API key required.

description: Turn an email address into a person: their name, photo, location, job, company and verified social accounts from their public Gravatar profile. Check whether someone has a Gravatar, get their picture as a link or a file at the size you need, with a stand-in for people without one, find profiles from a GitHub or X username, and make a QR code that opens a profile. No account or API key required.
